items.question: What makes information Confidential Information under the Northbridge NDA?
items.answer: Under the Northbridge NDA, Confidential Information is defined as "all information disclosed by a Party (the 'Discloser') to the other (the 'Recipient') in connection with the Purpose, in any form, that is marked confidential or would reasonably be understood to be confidential" [1].
